name: loopseed
description: Game-first creative dialogue, One-Shot production, no-idle Fan-out, and evidence-governed completion.

interface.shortDescription: Aim game ideas through dialogue, then launch verified One-Shot production.
interface.longDescription: LoopSeed is a game-first AI production engine. It co-directs an unfinished idea through bounded dialogue, locks a user-authorized creative brief, then executes one uninterrupted production run with no-idle controlled Fan-out, independent verification, repair, and fail-closed finalization. General projects use a lighter domain adapter.
defaultPrompt: $loopseed one-shotted Help me sharpen and amplify this game idea through meaningful options, then launch the complete production run once the creative brief is locked.
$loopseed one-shotted <one natural-language game or product seed>
$loopseed Complete this scoped goal through the smallest evidence-driven loop; continue until verified or truly blocked.
